transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm here because I've been struggling with episodes where I eat an unusually large amount of food all at once. When this happens, I feel a complete loss of control and feel like I just can't stop myself.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, misuse of laxatives, or excessive exercising?
No, I don't do any of those things. I've never tried to make myself throw up, use laxatives, or exercise excessively after it happens.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa]. Based on the patient's explicit denial of compensatory behaviors such as self-induced vomiting, laxative misuse, or excessive exercise, Bulimia Nervosa is ruled out, leaving Binge-Eating Disorder as the remaining candidate.
